headline: Easy breeding chain: Beakon
title: Easy Beakon Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: This three step chain takes you from easy Pals all the way to Beakon. Step one: breed Grintale with Incineram to get Elizabee. Step two: breed that Elizabee with Kitsun to get Tarantriss. Step three: breed Tarantriss with Vanwyrm, and the egg hatches into Beakon! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Beakon: Grintale + Incineram = Elizabee, Elizabee + Kitsun = Tarantriss, Tarantriss + Vanwyrm = Beakon. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
